tasks.lift_blue_block_drawer: pick up the blue block from the drawer
tasks.lift_blue_block_slider: pick up the blue block from the sliding cabinet
tasks.lift_blue_block_table: pick up the blue block from the table
tasks.lift_pink_block_drawer: pick up the pink block from the drawer
tasks.lift_pink_block_slider: pick up the pink block from the sliding cabinet
tasks.lift_pink_block_table: pick up the pink block from the table
tasks.lift_red_block_drawer: pick up the red block from the drawer
tasks.lift_red_block_slider: pick up the red block from the sliding cabinet
tasks.lift_red_block_table: pick up the red block from the table
tasks.move_slider_left: move the sliding door to the left
tasks.move_slider_right: move the sliding door to the right
tasks.place_in_drawer: place the held block in the drawer
tasks.place_in_slider: place the held block in the sliding cabinet
tasks.push_into_drawer: push the block into the drawer
tasks.turn_off_led: press the button to turn off the led
tasks.turn_off_lightbulb: move the switch to turn off the lightbulb
tasks.turn_on_led: press the button to turn on the led
tasks.turn_on_lightbulb: move the switch to turn on the lightbulb
tasks.unstack_block: remove the top block from the stack

tasks.push_blue_block_left: push the blue block to the left
tasks.push_blue_block_right: push the blue block to the right
tasks.push_pink_block_left: push the pink block to the left
tasks.push_pink_block_right: push the pink block to the right
tasks.push_red_block_left: push the red block to the left
tasks.push_red_block_right: push the red block to the right
tasks.stack_block: stack one block on top of another block
